messages:
Maria (CS): Kicking off week0 for Aegis Priv VPC. Quick checklist: network peering validated? KMS key access for redwood-agent? audit log ingestion to Splunk? sample rates? we're seeing a renewal risk if logs delay.
Sandeep (Solutions): Hi! I validated firewall rules — egress to splunk collector blocked on 10.4.5.7:5044. Need security team to open.
Harry (Infra): On it. Opening ticket to cloud fw team.
Harry (Infra): Created ticket CLD-4821. @sandeep can you paste tcpdump or curl test?
Sandeep (Solutions): here's curl from bastion:
```bash
curl -v --max-time 5 https://splunk-collector.aegis.company:5044 || echo 'fail'
```
Sandeep (Solutions): returns connection timed out.
ops-bot: Automated note: Audit pipeline last successful delivery 2026-03-18T09:12:30Z — 3h ago.
Maria (CS): Hmm. Also KMS: customer asks that we use a customer-managed key with rotation policy 90d. Do we have KMS IAM bound to redwood-inference-role?
Harry (Infra): Not yet. I can add role binding but need the customer's KMS ARN and their IAM principal.
Maria (CS): They've provided: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01. Also their ops principal is aegis-kms-role@123456789012.
Sandeep (Solutions): I'll request the minimal policy snippet.
Sandeep (Solutions): policy snippet:
```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"}
```
Harry (Infra): Will apply to redwood-inference-role and confirm.
Auditsys (bot): Audit config check: S3 delivery enabled? Yes. CloudTrail integration? Missing. Recommend enabling CloudTrail for management events.
Maria (CS): Ok action list: 1) firewall ticket CLD-4821 (Harry), 2) bind KMS policy (Harry), 3) validate Splunk ingestion (Sandeep), 4) enable CloudTrail (customer ops). @Harry @Sandeep can we aim for EOD PST?
Harry (Infra): EOD PST is tight but ok for binding KMS, firewall depends on cloud team ETA.
Sandeep (Solutions): I'll do validation and post results here.
Maria (CS): Thanks. If blockers, we'll pivot to queued EU-hosted fallback to avoid renewal risk. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Harry (Infra): noted.
Sandeep (Solutions): Posting follow-up when curl succeeds or logs start flowing.
Maria (CS): thanks all.
